name: Date picker
description: A date field with a button that opens a calendar for choosing a day. Use it when the date is close to today or the weekday matters, such as booking a stay; people should still be able to type the date.
summary: Choose a date from a calendar popup
htmlElement: <input> and <button> opening a <dialog> with a date grid

elements.name: Field
elements.description: Accepts a typed date in the stated format

elements.name: Calendar button
elements.description: Opens the calendar; has a name such as "Choose date"

elements.name: Calendar
elements.description: Month heading, previous and next buttons, and a grid of days in a Dialog or Popover

variants.caption: Range — start and end days with the span between
Inline — calendar always visible, no popup

usageNotes: Choose a Date picker for dates near today, such as appointments or bookings, where seeing the weekday helps. For birth dates and other known dates, a Date input is faster.
Always let people type the date. The calendar is a helper, and a typed field is easier for many keyboard and screen reader users.
Follow the APG Date Picker Dialog example: the button opens a dialog, arrow keys move through the grid of days, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.
Give each day an accessible name with the full date, not just the number, and mark today and the selected day in a way that doesn't rely on color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
Show unavailable dates as disabled rather than hiding them, and tell people why a date can't be chosen when the reason isn't obvious.
